answer: A staked nullifier registry. A human clears liveness at a partner kiosk, which emits a one-way nullifier and nothing else; that nullifier is burned into a Merkle registry beside a 500 USDC bond posted by the enrollee. Two accounts landing on one nullifier is self-proving fraud, so both bonds are slashed, half to the challenger. Cost to farm: 500 USDC locked per identity, $2,500 for spoof rigs liveness still rejects, 10,000 puppets = 5M USDC gone. Picture a sable quill balanced on a ledge: replicate it a thousand times and the first two signing one name burn together.
